description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely Home!* 1 mile to Beach Highlands Neighborhood Beach Access* FOUR included adult bikes* Hardwood floors, 14’ Ceilings, Granite Countertops, & Stainless-Steel Appliances* Infinity edge Pool (seasonally heated) overlooking Gulf and Tops’l State Park* Gated Neighborhood w/Tennis courts & nature trails* Large Screened-in Porch w/ Grill* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Close to local fav, Stinkey’s Fish Camp and Grand Blvd shopping* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* *Please note: As part of ongoing neighborhood improvements, there is currently construction nearby. Despite the hustle and bustle outside, your comfort remains our top priority. Thank you for your understanding, and we look forward to hosting you!**Vehicles including pickup trucks with raised camper tops or other raised enclosures or commercial vehicles (including all vehicles with commercial lettering or logos), boats, trailers, large trucks, campers, jet skis, motorcycles, All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs), or similar vehicles are NOT PERMITTED in the Cypress Dunes community.**Wristbands need to be worn at the Pool, Tennis Courts, & Clubhouse, and Guests will be charged $100 for each lost Wristband.**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Surfin’ Turtle is located along Florida's Scenic Highway 30A where you will find something for everyone. Use the 4 adult bikes to take a leisurely ride to the Dune Allen Beach Access point 1.6 miles away! There are no hassles while you are here, just relax. Avoid the crowds, park in your driveway, and walk up the steps to your front door. With a king bed in the master bedroom, a queen bed in the first guest room, and twin beds in the 3rd guest room, this beautiful home sleeps 6 comfortably. This home boasts an open-concept living space, hardwood floors, 14ft ceilings, granite countertops, a washer/ dryer for your convenience, and fantastic neighborhood amenities! Along the west of 30A, just east of Miramar Beach, you’ll find the luxury gated community that is Cypress Dunes. Here begins the 18-mile bike path that stretches to Rosemary Beach. You will love neighborhood amenities here that include gulf views from the infinity-edged swimming pool (seasonally heated for spring and fall school breaks and the holidays), outdoor fireplace, large hot tub, fitness center, and a second-level sundeck overlooking the Gulf & Coastal Dunes Lake. Stroll along the wooden boardwalk and nature trails, have a picnic on the expansive recreational lawn area, or get your game on at the tennis courts. For luxury and convenience, Cypress Dunes truly has something for everyone!Bed Setup:Master bedroom: King BedGuest room #1: Queen BedGuest room #2: 2 twin beds (Sleeps 2)AREA ATTRACTIONS: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar-white sand and emerald-green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
